description: She wears an opaque deep burgundy floor-length overdress with a high soft square neckline near the collarbones. A fine ivory long-sleeved underdress provides full wrist-length sleeves and a visible narrow center skirt panel. Narrow gold patterned woven borders frame the neckline, cuffs and hem. A matching burgundy mantle hangs from the shoulders and is fastened at one side by a round decorative gold brooch. A narrow brown decorated belt sits at the waist. Brown closed leather shoes are visible below the skirt. Cloth appears substantial and woven; exact fiber is uncertain.
